name: Claude Monet
note: He painted the same subject many times, to catch how the light changes it.

name: Théodore Géricault
note: He studied real shipwreck survivors, and even bodies in hospitals, to paint the Medusa.

name: Eugène Delacroix
note: A painter of colour and movement, he was inspired by the events of his own time.

name: Jean-François Millet
note: He painted the hard daily life of peasants, which shocked some people in Paris.

name: Auguste Rodin
note: He left the marks of his hands in the clay: his sculptures look alive and unfinished.
